sloka: तद्वभूवाद्भुतं घोरं युद्धं वानररक्षसाम् ।शिलाभिर्विविधाभिश्च बहुभिश्चैव पादपैः ।। ६.५२.९ ।।।।
transliteration: tadvabhūvādbhutaṁ ghoraṁ yuddhaṁ vānararakṣasām ।śilābhirvividhābhiśca bahubhiścaiva pādapaiḥ ।। 6.52.9 ।।।।

translations.english: Wonderful fight took place between Vanaras and Rakshasas who held trees and rocks of several kinds.
